description: Track 6 Step 2c.5 Phase 2 — operators flagged as downstream-critical. The --commit pass surfaces any LLM decision affecting one of these for human review (no auto-approve), regardless of confidence. Substring match (case-insensitive) against public.operators.canonical_name AND public.operator_aliases.alias.
rationale: These 20 operators concentrate the bulk of US fractional / large-fleet charter activity. An incorrect alias or rebrand merge here propagates to every downstream analytic (route_intel, operator_market_share, fleet_stats). Better to surface a few high-priority decisions for human review than auto-approve a downstream-critical merge based on LLM confidence alone.
policy: intentionally over-inclusive — substring matching catches subsidiary LLCs (e.g., 'Wheels Up Partners LLC') under their parent brand string ('Wheels Up'), which is the correct conservative choice for surface-for-review.
